title: Census of India 2011 — Primary Census Abstract
description: Population, sex split, Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe population, rural/urban split, households, workers and the four worker categories, literacy and sex ratio for all 640 districts. District tables A-1 and A-2 give area, density and the 2001-11 growth rate.
publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI)
license: Government of India open data (GoI Open Data Licence)

title: India State of Forest Report 2023 — district-wise forest cover
description: Forest cover in square kilometres and as a share of geographic area, for every state and 750 districts, with very dense, moderately dense and open forest and scrub broken out.
publisher: Forest Survey of India, Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

title: Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25
description: Net State Domestic Product and per-capita income at current prices, GSVA by activity (agriculture, industry, services), installed power capacity, road length and railway route kilometres, state by state.
license: Reserve Bank of India, free to reproduce with attribution

title: Land Use Statistics — Directorate of Economics & Statistics
description: The nine-fold land-use classification by state: forest, area not available for cultivation, permanent pasture, land under miscellaneous tree crops, culturable waste, fallow and net sown area. Reproduced in ISFR 2023 Volume 2, Table 10.x.1.
publisher: Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

title: Terrarium terrain tiles
description: Global elevation as encoded PNG tiles: SRTM at 30 m, ASTER GDEM and ETOPO1 for the ocean, resampled to web-mercator tiles. Decoded to metres per pixel and averaged inside each hex.
publisher: Mapzen / AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles
license: Public domain and open (SRTM, ASTER GDEM, ETOPO1)

title: Natural Earth 1:10m vectors
description: Rivers and lake centre lines, roads, railways and country boundaries, used for the drawn rivers, the highway and rail links and the neighbouring land.

title: District and state boundaries
description: District polygons for all 720 districts of India with state codes, dissolved to the 36 states and union territories.
publisher: Survey of India-derived open boundary set (india-maps-data)
license: Open (MIT for the code, boundaries as published)

title: Global Power Plant Database
description: Power stations of 100 MW and above with coordinates, capacity and fuel: coal, gas, oil, nuclear, hydro, solar and wind.

title: OurAirports
description: Airports with coordinates, type and IATA codes.

title: Periodic Labour Force Survey — industry shares
description: The share of each state's workers in agriculture, manufacturing, construction, trade, transport, finance, professional services, public administration, education and health, and arts and recreation, applied to Census worker counts to split them into industries.
publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)

title: Population projections for India and states 2011-2036
description: State population projections used for the 2024 population column.
publisher: National Commission on Population, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
